**HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.8 is the eighth release candidate.** HMG-API now brings up the Wi-Fi network wireless CarPlay and Android Auto join, for cars whose own apps don't, and brings it back after QuickBoot. It comes with **wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.0-rc.9**, which uses it and takes back rc.8's "chosen phone" change, so an iPhone can be picked again after an Android phone was used. 1.1.0 will be this code unless a blocker turns up. **This RC hasn't been checked on a car yet**, so please report how it goes. If you'd rather wait, stay on [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2): it's still the current release.

It comes with **Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto [2.2.0-rc.9](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.9)** and **ADB [1.0.1-rc.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-adb/releases/tag/v1.0.1-rc.1)**. NEMESIS in the app menu is the same as in rc.7.

## What's new since 1.1.0-rc.7

- **HMG-API brings up the projection Wi-Fi** for mods that ask (`"wifi": {"projection": true}`). On some cars nothing started the network wireless Android Auto joins: on a US Sorento Plug-in Hybrid (260507, #314) Android Auto never got going. HMG-API now starts it from boot, before the phone's Bluetooth reconnects. It's left alone when it's already up or the car's own Wi-Fi client is on.
- **After QuickBoot** (switching the car off and on without the head unit restarting), HMG-API checks that network again.
- **For mods:** `hmgapi.hook.Wifi.projectionAp(context, who)` brings it up right when a phone attaches. Wireless 2.2.0-rc.9 calls it before every CarPlay attach.
- **Wireless 2.2.0-rc.9:** an iPhone shows up in Device Connections again after an Android phone was used (wireless #91): rc.8's park-and-leave ending and "chosen phone" are taken back for now. See [its notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.9).
- The full list is in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/blob/v1.1.0-rc.8/CHANGELOG.md).

## Installing

- **From 1.0.x, the beta or an earlier RC:** put `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.8-update.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick, then HMG-API app → **Check USB updates**. Restart the head unit once afterwards. Your mods and settings stay. To update the wireless mod too, also put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.2.0-rc.9.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/`, pick it in Check USB updates, and **Apply changes**. Wireless 2.2.0-rc.9 needs this RC: update HMG-API first.
- **With NEMESIS:** unzip `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.8-nemesis.zip` onto a stick and update from NEMESIS Manager's Package Store.
- **New install, or after a firmware update:** follow [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API), with `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.8-usb.zip`.

## What to test

- **After updating:** the app shows **1.1.0-rc.8** and "Hooks on" on a car that had them, and your mods still run after a restart.
- **Wireless Android Auto on a car where it never connected** (the US Sorento Plug-in Hybrid and other 260507 Kias): does it connect after a cold start?
- **Wireless CarPlay and Android Auto where they already worked** (the EV6 and others): still connecting after a cold start, and after switching the car off and on again a few minutes later (QuickBoot).
- **An iPhone and an Android phone on one car:** after using Android Auto, the iPhone shows a CarPlay icon in Device Connections again.
- **Home Wi-Fi**, if you use it: it still joins while parked, and CarPlay or Android Auto comes back when you start the car.
- Logs for the above: `/data/hmgapi/logs/hmgapi/wifi.log`, or **Record a problem**.

## Known issues

- Bluetooth Audio can take audio focus at a cold start before CarPlay or Android Auto is up. A fix is in review (wireless #56).
- The rest are the same as in [1.0.0](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.0). For example, a USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting, so take the stick out after installing.

## Going back to 1.0.2

Older release candidates are no longer offered; [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2) is the release to go back to. The app won't install an older HMG-API over a newer one, so either:
- **With adb:** `adb push hmgapi-1.0.2-update.zip /data/local/tmp/`, then `adb shell hmgapid engine update-hmgapi /data/local/tmp/hmgapi-1.0.2-update.zip --force`. Restart the head unit.
- **Without adb:** uninstall HMG-API ([Uninstalling](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Uninstalling), without `PURGE`, so your mods and settings stay), restart, then install 1.0.2 as new.

Wireless 2.2.0-rc.9 needs HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.8, so going back to 1.0.2 means going back to wireless 2.1.0 too: remove the mod in the app and apply, then install `wireless-carplay-aa-2.1.0.zip` from 1.0.2's release with Check USB updates.

## Reporting

Open an [issue](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) with your car, its head unit software (e.g. 260507), the HMG-API version and your mods, and a Car Report if you can.
